item.title: Gina Hinojosa; primera gobernadora hispana y artífice del regreso demócrata a Texas 30 años después

item.title: South Africans vote amid growing discontent over failing services and infrastructure
item.description: South Africans head to the polls on Wednesday for local government elections, with voters set to choose their municipal representatives amid growing concerns over unemployment, crime, water shortages and the delivery of basic services. Fuente: Africanews.

item.title: ‘We will take back the House in 2028’: US House Speaker Johnson promises Republican comeback
item.description: US House Speaker Mike Johnson has urged Republicans not to lose hope after Democrats made major gains in the 2026 midterm elections. Johnson vowed that Republicans would double down on their agenda and seek to retake the House in 2028. Fuente: Euronews.
